steps.name: Schwarz
steps.text: Alpha, Bravo, stay back and monitor them carefully. Charlie, wrap around and flank them.

steps.name: Hellagur
steps.text: Mercenaries, huh...

steps.name: Hellagur
steps.text: Whoever trained them must've been rather skilled. Not bad, but also not good enough.

steps.name: Bodyguard
steps.text: Th-this old man is strong!

steps.name: Schwarz
steps.text: You're no match for him. Stand by for now.

steps.name: Hellagur
steps.text: (This woman... won't be simple to deal with.)

steps.name: Hellagur
steps.text: (These bodyguards won't be able to harm me, but she poses a threat.)

steps.name: Schwarz
steps.text: Foolish outsiders...

steps.name: Hellagur
steps.text: (She's angry now.)

steps.name: Hellagur
steps.text: (Perhaps from her perspective, she really believes that we deceived Miss Ceylon.)

steps.name: Hellagur
steps.text: (But, something's not right. Just who is she...)

steps.name: Hellagur
steps.text: You must be a pretty experienced mercenary, staying disciplined even though your Mistress is gone.

steps.name: Bodyguard
steps.text: Cut the crap! Since you know that our boss was... Ugh...

steps.name: Schwarz
steps.text: Shut up.

steps.name: Hellagur
steps.text: (Hmm...? Wait... A crossbow, Feline, and that name...)

steps.name: Hellagur
steps.text: (Where have I heard that name before...)

steps.name: Bodyguard
steps.text: Wait, what is this geezer doing?!

steps.name: Hellagur
steps.text: (I'm a bit worried about how the Doctor is doing.)

steps.name: Hellagur
steps.text: (...But the Doctor is capable enough, as are the others. There shouldn't be any issue.)

steps.name: Bodyguard
steps.text: Is he senile or something? He's charging straight at us!

steps.name: Bodyguard
steps.text: Hurry, stop him!!!

steps.name: Hellagur
steps.text: You'll have to be faster than that!
